name: run-and-fix-loop
description: Bounded run -> read error -> one targeted fix -> re-run loop for Code tasks. Designed for small local models: enforces a hard step cap so the model makes exactly one targeted fix per iteration and stops instead of spinning on repeated failures.

run_command.description: The exact command to run each iteration (e.g. 'npm test', 'npm run build', 'pytest')

max_iterations.description: Maximum number of run-fix iterations before stopping (default to a small number like 3 if unset)

context.description: Context about the code and failure to guide the targeted fix (language, build tool, test runner, suspected cause)

steps.template:
Context: {{context}}

Step 1 — Set the loop bound:
- Do NOT exceed {{max_iterations}} iterations of the run-fix loop
- If max_iterations is unset, default to a small number (such as 3)
- Each iteration is: run the command, read the error, apply exactly ONE targeted fix, re-run
- Once the bound is reached, STOP and report the remaining failures instead of continuing

Step 2 — Read and fix:
- Read the full error output from the command
- Identify the FIRST root cause (the earliest failure, not downstream symptoms)
- Select exactly ONE targeted fix for that single root cause
- Apply only that one fix — do not make unrelated changes in the same iteration

Step 3 — Re-run and decide:
- Re-run the same command ({{run_command}}) via the terminal
- If it passes (zero failures/errors), report SUCCESS and STOP
- If it still fails AND the {{max_iterations}} bound is not yet reached, repeat from Step 2 (read the error, apply one targeted fix)
- If it still fails AND the bound is reached, STOP and report the remaining failures (names, counts, error messages)
